g.text: The data flywheel: a loop that must be closed and clean
usage gives feedback, feedback improves the model, the product draws users
+ feedback is a by-product of normal use
+ the signal is specific to the task
+ the team retrains or re-tunes and measures
+ users consented to the data use
- feedback bias: only angry users click thumbs-down
- logging without labels: data with no ground truth
interview framing: name the data source, the signal, the label, the loop, and the consent
